about: Words left over after a reading are dropped, and what was read is restated before it through the world's `understood`: `push` has no `with` phrase, so `push the menhir with the sword` is `push the menhir`, and a trailing word or clause no phrase reads goes the same way, `and` and a command after it included. A noun dropped with them is dropped whatever it names, `in case` after `drop sword` among them. A relative phrase that names something is read whole, and `again` runs what was read. A noun that names nothing in reach in a slot of its own is never dropped: `drop sword on gong` and `look at gong` are `not_here`, though `drop sword` and `look` would read, and so is a line whose first words name nothing.
